title: Valar Atomics header
description: A fixed, transparent bar in difference blend (white over black bands, black over light ones): a mark and a two-line extra-wide caps wordmark on the left, six mono caps links on the right. The wordmark and links fade away over the first few hundred pixels of scroll, leaving only the mark; on phones a wave-icon button opens a full-screen black link panel.
notes: fixed to the top and transparent: the first section runs under it (76px phones, 106px desktop)
the fade is a CSS scroll timeline (no JS); the phone menu needs JavaScript
mix-blend-difference needs white ink, so the bar is a `dark` scope: it reads on any theme's light and dark bands
name: valaratomics-header

props.name: wordmark
props.description: the company name as two short lines, e.g. ["Tallgrass", "Fission"]: set in the wide caps face

props.name: mark
props.description: the brand mark beside it (an svg, img or lucide icon); it stays when the rest fades

props.name: homeLabel
props.description: accessible name of the home link, e.g. "Tallgrass Fission home"

props.name: links
props.description: the links: in a row from 1024px, in the menu panel on phones

props.name: menuIcon
props.description: the phone menu button's icon when closed (e.g. lucide WavesHorizontal)

props.name: closeIcon
props.description: the phone menu button's icon when open (e.g. lucide X)

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: accessible name of the phone menu button, e.g. "Menu"
